about_short_description.short_description: Numero is a campaign financial software that manages payment processing, accounting, and compliance for their campaigns.

product.name: Donor Database
product.description: A database system that manages and filters donor information to identify the best prospects and prevent duplicates.

product.name: Call Time App
product.description: A mobile application that facilitates campaign fundraising calls by managing call lists and logging call outcomes.

product.name: Contribution Forms
product.description: Online forms that enable donors to make political contributions with features like auto-fill and fast loading.

product.name: Event Tools
product.description: Software tools for managing campaign fundraising events, including RSVP tracking and automated reminders.

product.name: Email Fundraising Platform
product.description: An email marketing system tailored for political campaigns to increase donation rates and manage donor communications.
